COMMERCE · PROJECT

Seller onboarding experience

Getting a new marketplace seller to their first sale: one step at a time, with help exactly where they get stuck.

Has anybody already built a conversational-based onboarding experience?

THE PROJECT · 4 SCREENS

The question

What does a new seller on an e-commerce platform actually need from onboarding?

The approach

Focus on one thing at a time and hide the rest. Import what the user already has — a catalog on their site, documents in a Drive folder — and let agents cross-check it. Put help inline exactly where they get stuck, answer the broader “how long will this take?” questions, and make mistakes easy to fix.

The tradeoff

Taking work off the user’s plate means trusting agents to read and verify their data, so the product has to show its checks and make corrections painless.

What to take with you

Users care about more business and an easier life. AI features only matter as a means to that end.
